source: Sanitized from an authenticated, read-only inspection of the current LinkedIn desktop UI.

send_initial_dialog.heading: Add a note to your invitation?

send_note_dialog.heading: Add a note to your invitation
send_note_dialog.textbox_placeholder: Ex: We know each other from…

send_execution_contract.success: A fresh exact-profile read visibly shows Pending.
send_execution_contract.failure: A fresh exact-profile read still visibly shows Connect.
send_execution_contract.uncertain: The final click or fresh exact-profile state cannot be verified.

postconditions.send: A fresh exact-profile load visibly exposes Pending for success or Connect for failure.
postconditions.accept: The exact profile removes both request controls and visibly exposes a first-degree connection plus Message.
postconditions.ignore: A fresh exact-profile read removes both request controls without exposing a first-degree connection.

notes: The current direct profile action was revalidated through a read-only live Playwright trace as a button named Invite {name} to connect; the dialog, counter, and send-control contract was previously revalidated through a live read/prepare MCP run. The synthetic send fixture models only the public contract: Pending after a fresh exact-profile load is success, while Connect is failure. It retains no live identity, raw DOM, browser state, or generated CSS class.
